variables.agentRunsQuery:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "exploration-agent" and Name == "invoke_agent"
| summarize Runs=count(), Failures=countif(Success == false), P95DurationMs=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
variables.stageLatencyQuery:
AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName == "exploration-agent" and Name == "expl.stage.duration_ms"
| extend Stage=tostring(todynamic(Properties)["stage"])
| summarize P50Ms=percentile(Sum, 50), P95Ms=percentile(Sum, 95) by Stage, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
variables.qualityQuery:
AppEvents
| where Name == "gen_ai.evaluation.result"
| extend Evaluation=tostring(todynamic(Properties)["gen_ai.evaluation.name"]), Label=tostring(todynamic(Properties)["gen_ai.evaluation.score.label"]), Score=todouble(todynamic(Properties)["gen_ai.evaluation.score.value"])
| summarize Samples=count(), PassRate=100.0 * countif(Label == "pass") / count(), MeanScore=avg(Score) by Evaluation, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
variables.browserQuery:
AppEvents
| where AppRoleName == "exploration-web"
| where Name startswith "exploration.chat." or Name == "exploration.feedback.submitted"
| summarize Events=count() by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
variables.backendComparisonQuery:
let responseTime = AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName in ("exploration-agent", "exploration-agent-postgres") and Name == "invoke_agent"
| extend Provider=tostring(todynamic(Properties)["exploration.retrieval_provider"])
| where Provider in ("azure", "postgres")
| summarize Samples=count(), P50Ms=percentile(DurationMs, 50), P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by Provider
| extend Metric="End-to-end response time", Tokens=long(null), QualityMean=real(null), QualityPassRate=real(null);
let retrievalTime = AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName in ("exploration-agent", "exploration-agent-postgres") and Name == "expl.stage.duration_ms"
| extend Dimensions=todynamic(Properties)
| extend Provider=tostring(Dimensions["retrieval_provider"]), Stage=tostring(Dimensions["stage"])
| where Provider in ("azure", "postgres") and Stage == "retrieve"
| summarize Samples=sum(ItemCount), P50Ms=percentile(Sum, 50), P95Ms=percentile(Sum, 95) by Provider
| extend Metric="Retrieval stage time", Tokens=long(null), QualityMean=real(null), QualityPassRate=real(null);
let tokens = AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName in ("exploration-agent", "exploration-agent-postgres") and Name == "expl.tokens"
| extend Dimensions=todynamic(Properties)
| extend Provider=tostring(Dimensions["retrieval_provider"])
| where Provider in ("azure", "postgres")
| summarize Tokens=sum(Sum) by Provider
| extend Metric="Model token consumption", Samples=long(null), P50Ms=real(null), P95Ms=real(null), QualityMean=real(null), QualityPassRate=real(null);
let groundedQuality = AppEvents
| where Name == "gen_ai.evaluation.result"
| extend Dimensions=todynamic(Properties)
| extend Provider=tostring(Dimensions["exploration.retrieval_provider"])
| where Dimensions["gen_ai.evaluation.name"] == "answer_quality" and Provider in ("azure", "postgres")
| summarize Samples=count(), QualityMean=avg(todouble(Dimensions["gen_ai.evaluation.score.value"])), QualityPassRate=100.0 * countif(Dimensions["gen_ai.evaluation.score.label"] == "pass") / count() by Provider
| extend Metric="Grounded answer quality", P50Ms=real(null), P95Ms=real(null), Tokens=long(null);
union responseTime, retrievalTime, tokens, groundedQuality
| project Provider, Metric, Samples, P50Ms, P95Ms, Tokens, QualityMean, QualityPassRate
| order by Metric asc, Provider asc

alertDefinitions.name: exploration-agent-failure-rate-workspace
alertDefinitions.description: At least five chat requests occurred and 20 percent or more failed within 15 minutes.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppDependencies
  | where AppRoleName == "exploration-agent" and Name == "invoke_agent"
  | summarize Total=count(), Failures=countif(Success == false)
| where Total >= 5 and 100.0 * Failures / Total >= 20.0

alertDefinitions.name: exploration-agent-high-latency-workspace
alertDefinitions.description: Agent-run p95 duration exceeded two minutes within 30 minutes.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppDependencies
  | where AppRoleName == "exploration-agent" and Name == "invoke_agent"
  | summarize P95DurationMs=percentile(DurationMs, 95)
| where P95DurationMs > 120000.0

alertDefinitions.name: exploration-golden-quality-regression-workspace
alertDefinitions.description: At least one answer-quality golden-set evaluation failed within 24 hours.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppEvents
  | where Name == "gen_ai.evaluation.result"
  | extend Properties=todynamic(Properties)
  | where tostring(Properties["gen_ai.evaluation.name"]) == "answer_quality"
  | where tostring(Properties["gen_ai.evaluation.score.label"]) == "fail"
| summarize Failures=count()
| where Failures > 0

variables.retrievalQuery:

let fallbacks = AppMetrics

    Clarification=countif(tostring(P["maintenance.outcome"]) == "clarification"),

variables.qualityQuery:

variables.releaseQuery:
let turns = AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent" and Name startswith "invoke_agent"
| extend Version=tostring(Properties["maintenance.app_version"]), ResponseId=tostring(Properties["gen_ai.response.id"]), TtftMs=toreal(Properties["maintenance.ttft_ms"]), Outcome=tostring(Properties["maintenance.outcome"]);

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-agent-error-rate
alertDefinitions.description: At least five turns and 20 percent or more ended in an agent failure within 15 minutes.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent" and Name startswith "invoke_agent"
| summarize Total=count(), Errors=countif(tostring(Properties["maintenance.outcome"]) == "error")
| where Total >= 5 and 100.0 * Errors / Total >= 20.0

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-agent-slow-first-token
alertDefinitions.description: Time to first answer token p95 exceeded 25 seconds over at least five turns in 30 minutes.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent" and Name startswith "invoke_agent"
| extend TtftMs=toreal(Properties["maintenance.ttft_ms"])
| where isnotnull(TtftMs)
| summarize Turns=count(), TtftP95Ms=percentile(TtftMs, 95)
| where Turns >= 5 and TtftP95Ms > 25000.0

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-agent-retrieval-legs-failing
alertDefinitions.description: At least ten retrieval legs ran and 20 percent or more failed or timed out within 30 minutes.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent" and Name == "execute_tool evidence_search"
| summarize Legs=count(), Failures=countif(Success == false)
| where Legs >= 10 and 100.0 * Failures / Legs >= 20.0

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-agent-invalid-citations
alertDefinitions.displayName: Maintenance answer cited an unknown source
alertDefinitions.description: An answer cited a source id that was not retrieved for the turn (zero tolerance).
alertDefinitions.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent" and Name startswith "invoke_agent"
| where tobool(Properties["maintenance.guardrail.invalid_citations"])
| summarize Turns=count()
| where Turns > 0

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-agent-kg-fallbacks
alertDefinitions.displayName: Maintenance knowledge graph falling back to snapshot
alertDefinitions.description: Knowledge graph calls fell back to the snapshot at least five times within 30 minutes.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent" and Name == "maint.kg.fallbacks"
| summarize Fallbacks=sum(Sum)
| where Fallbacks >= 5

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-agent-throttling
alertDefinitions.displayName: Maintenance agent throttled by a dependency
alertDefinitions.description: At least five dependency calls returned HTTP 429 within 15 minutes.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent" and ResultCode == "429"
| summarize Throttled=count()
| where Throttled >= 5

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-eval-gate-failed
alertDefinitions.description: A golden-set evaluation run reported a failed promotion gate.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppEvents
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-evaluation" and Name == "maintenance.eval.run"
| where tostring(Properties["maintenance.eval.gate"]) == "fail"
| summarize Runs=count()
| where Runs > 0

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-agent-telemetry-silent
alertDefinitions.description: Backend pods are running but sent no telemetry for 15 minutes (exporter or ingestion broken).
alertDefinitions.query:
let items = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true AppMetrics, AppPerformanceCounters, AppRequests
    | where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent"
    | count);
KubePodInventory
| where Namespace == "crv" and Name startswith "backend-" and PodStatus == "Running"
| summarize Pods=dcount(Name)
| where Pods > 0 and items == 0

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-agent-negative-feedback
alertDefinitions.description: At least five user votes in 24 hours and fewer than 60 percent were positive.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppEvents
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-agent" and Name == "gen_ai.evaluation.result"
| where tostring(Properties["microsoft.gen_ai.human_evaluation.source"]) == "end_user"
| summarize Votes=count(), Up=countif(tostring(Properties["gen_ai.evaluation.score.label"]) == "pass")
| where Votes >= 5 and 100.0 * Up / Votes < 60.0

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-online-groundedness-drop
alertDefinitions.description: At least ten sampled live answers were judged in 24 hours and fewer than 80 percent were grounded.
alertDefinitions.query:
AppEvents
| where AppRoleName == "maintenance-evaluation" and Name == "gen_ai.evaluation.result"
| where tostring(Properties["maintenance.eval.suite"]) == "online" and tostring(Properties["gen_ai.evaluation.name"]) == "groundedness"
| summarize Judged=count(), Passed=countif(tostring(Properties["gen_ai.evaluation.score.label"]) == "pass")
| where Judged >= 10 and 100.0 * Passed / Judged < 80.0

alertDefinitions.name: maintenance-backend-restarts
alertDefinitions.description: A backend container restarted (crash or OOM kill) within 30 minutes.
alertDefinitions.query:
KubePodInventory
| where Namespace == "crv" and Name startswith "backend-"
| summarize Restarts=max(ContainerRestartCount) - min(ContainerRestartCount) by Name
| where Restarts > 0
